claims.head: A tough night ahead for Reinhart
claims.call: The Blackhawks’ P2 (Cole and Vlasic) spends at least 62% of its 5-on-5 time against the Panthers’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Blackhawks keep sending Cole and Vlasic out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Jeff Blashill has been picking a defense pair for the other team’s top line. Tonight the Panthers’ first line is Verhaeghe, Reinhart and Eller.

claims.head: The Panthers hit, the Blackhawks mostly don’t
claims.body: On physicality, Florida is the league’s best, but Chicago is one of the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Expect most of the big hits to come from the Panthers.

notes.text: Aleksander Barkov is on long-term injured reserve (lower-body injury) and has missed the last 9 games. He is one of their best players.
Gustav Forsling is day to day (upper-body injury), reported after he played in their last game. He is a top-four defenseman.
Brad Marchand is on injured reserve (leg injury) and has missed the last 7 games. He is a top-six forward.
Cooper Black was added to the roster on Oct 14.
Cooper Black was added to the roster on Oct 21.
Cole Reinhardt was added to the roster on Oct 23 and has played beside Eetu Luostarinen and Anton Lundell.
Cole Schwindt was added to the roster on Oct 23 and has played beside Garnet Hathaway and Bokondji Imama.
Bowen Byram is out (upper-body injury) and has missed the last 3 games. He is a top-pair defenseman. Wyatt Kaiser has taken his spot beside Artyom Levshunov.
Dominic Toninato was added to the roster on Oct 14 and has played beside Ryan Donato and Oliver Moore.
Artyom Levshunov is no longer playing on the power play: 4% of the team’s power-play time in 10 games, down from 59% last season.

CHI.head: The Blackhawks have a hill to climb
CHI.body: Even though Chicago has home-ice advantage and Florida will be without Barkov, the Panthers have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Blackhawks’ best way through is keeping dangerous shots away.

FLA.head: The matchup suits the Panthers
FLA.body: Even though Chicago has home-ice advantage and Florida will be without Barkov, the Panthers have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Blackhawks can make it interesting if they keep dangerous shots away.

story.head: The Panthers hit, the Blackhawks mostly don’t
paras: The Panthers come in at 5-4-2, the Blackhawks at 3-7-0.
At home, Jeff Blashill likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Panthers’ first line. The Cats hit a lot, but the Blackhawks mostly don’t.

items.text: The Panthers are newly without Jacob Markström and Gustav Forsling, and have been without Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand for several games. Akira Schmid is expected to start.
Sam Reinhart has five goals in six games against Chicago since 2023-24.
The Blackhawks are newly without Bowen Byram.
Carter Verhaeghe is set to play his 500th NHL game.
